'''''Limit of Vision''''' was a [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel]] [[Seltaya-class fast courier|''Seltaya''-class fast courier]] flown by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jai Maruk]] while performing recon missions along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] in the late stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Jedi Master Jai Maruk used the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to investigate [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] activity near the [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] [[Wayland system/Legends|system]]. The vessel was badly damaged when Maruk ran into Separatist forces near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]], and he was forced to land the ship there. He was then captured by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who injured Maruk but spared his life in order for him to deliver a message from [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. The ''Limit of Vision'' was also spared for Maruk to escape in.<ref name="DR" />

Upon Maruk's return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] espied the ship from [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|her apartment]], hoping that it was her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] returning from the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. Upon inspecting the ship more closely, however, Amidala concluded that it was not Skywalker.<ref name="DR" />

The ship was kept by [[Boz Addle]], the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] chief [[Engineer/Legends|mechanic]]. He had a special fondness for the ship, and was quietly dismayed by the damage it received during Maruk's mission. When Maruk returned to Coruscant to meet with Yoda and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], Maruk wryly apologized to Addle for the sorry state of the ship, whose damage included electrical sparking, [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorite]] pocking, [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] burns and several [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] impacts.<ref name="DR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Limit of Vision'' appears in the novel ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' by [[Sean Stewart]], in which it features in the first chapter. It makes no further appearances past this point. Despite the ''Seltaya''-class courier being listed later in the novel as employing an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], no mention is made of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in Maruk's vessel.
